note: Untested in a full run: the first recipe sized for one 16 GB GPU (RTX 5080 Laptop), 102M parameters with 32K-token windows, trained with --recompute --micro-batch 1. Changed on 2026-10-17: gated MLA became DeepSeek-V4's CSA (layer 4: 8 heads of 128 sharing one key-value head, an indexer of 8 heads of 128 and top 64, V4-Flash's scaled to the width) and HCA (layer 8), and the MTP block's attention a 128-token window; it grew from 101M to 102M parameters, and weights trained before no longer load. With --recompute on an integrated Radeon 860M, one window of random tokens peaked at 1.9 GiB at 4K tokens, 2.8 GiB at 8K, 4.6 GiB at 16K and 8.2 GiB at 32K; docs/training.md has the table. Its data is the classics for now (about 4.3M tokens, so the model mostly memorizes); it changes once a larger mixture exists. Since 2026-10-17 (recipe shape 4) its training is one stage: 300 steps of 8 windows of 32K tokens; DeepSeek-V4's stages to 1M tokens (4K, 16K, 64K, 1M) are not set yet, since their steps and batches are the recipe's to choose (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-17: recipes keep one stage for now). A GPU where 32K tokens do not fit trains it the same with --segment 8192 or --strategy split (docs/training.md, "Long windows").
